Exercise animations in this folder are dotLottie files from LottieFiles
(https://lottiefiles.com), used under the Lottie Simple License
(https://lottiefiles.com/page/license).

Vector Fitness Exercises (free exercise-library samples on LottieFiles):
- one-arm-row.lottie — Bench one arm dumbbell row
- deadlift.lottie — Barbell deadlift
- hammer-curl.lottie — Alternating dumbbell hammer curl
- bent-over-row.lottie — Barbell reverse grip bent over row
- hip-thrust.lottie — Barbell hip thrust (bundled; glutes use glute-bridge)
- renegade-row.lottie — Alternating renegade row
- hip-abduction.lottie — Cable hip abduction
- lat-pulldown.lottie — Cable close grip single arm pulldown
- dumbbell-swing.lottie — Dumbbell swing cardio
- overhead-triceps.lottie — Standing dumbbell overhead triceps extension
- preacher-curl.lottie — Dumbbell one arm preacher curl
- good-morning.lottie — Seated barbell good morning
- kneeling-row.lottie — Single arm half kneeling cable row
- overhead-arm-curl.lottie — Cable one arm overhead bicep curl (Vector Fitness sample)
- lateral-raise.lottie — Same Vector Fitness sample; motion matches a dumbbell side raise
